profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Atlassian | CS @ USC
profile.summary:
Hello :) I'm Skylar (pronouns: she/her) and I am a Software Engineer at Atlassian. I graduated from USC as a Computer Science major as Class of 2023.  
For work, I'm interested in backend development and distributed systems.
Outside of developing, I enjoy trying out restaurants, nature walks, baking, and spending time with loved ones!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
- Contribute to design and implement scalable backend systems using Java, leveraging frameworks like Spring Webflux to build and maintain non-blocking web apps. 
- Drive sub-initiatives for service maintenance, such as migrating service dependencies due to company's roadmap.
- Support team growth by mentoring junior engineers and sharing best practices in backend development
- Collaborate in a cross-functional setting, working with front-end developers and product managers to agree on requirements and deliver user-focused software solutions.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant
positions.description:
- Undergraduate TA for CSCI 104: Data Structures and Object Oriented Programming in C++
- Undergraduate TA for ITP 303: Full Stack Web Development
- Undergraduate TA for CSCI 103: Intro to Programming in C++

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
As a Backend Software Engineer Intern, I worked on the Cloud Enterprise team and created multiple REST API endpoints that were integrated together into one backend component. 
This backend component periodically validated and updated out-of-date customer data distributed across Atlassian's cloud infrastructure. This improved the customer experience when accessing the Atlassian Admin platform as up-to-date data is served to the customer instead of old data. 
Technologies: Java, AWS, NoSQL databases, Reactive Programming, Cloud Applications, REST APIs
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Cloud Applications · Microservices · Reactive Programming

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented Python software tools that automated AWS cloud expense reporting by calculating statistics and visualizing trends.
- Presented software design recommendations and gathered user feedback while conducting trade studies.
- Developed 5 sections of documentation and user guides for the NISAR and SWOT Science Data System knowledge base.

positions.title: Research And Development Intern
positions.description:
- Wrote programs in Python, C++ with LIDAR data and OpenCV packages to research network capability of the ROS framework and implement Python scripts that performed real-time object detection.
- Developed 25 sections of technical documentation that improved workflow in the R&D department.

honors.title: Ridgeline Scholarship
honors.description: $5k scholarship award given for achievements and involvements in STEM.
honors.issuer: Issued by Ridgeline International, Inc. · Sep 2020

volunteerExperiences.description:
- Worked closely with game developers and UI/UX designers to create an immersive, fully student-developed video game experience. 
- Conducted usability testing and collected continuous feedback to improve the user experience and story pacing.

projects.title: Sinking Inn
projects.description:
Student-lead indie video game project from Open Alpha. I was a game programmer, so I contributed to the implementation of game mechanics and game logic. 
Check out the game on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/1552460/Sinking_Inn/

projects.title: Networked GroundBots
projects.description: Ridgeline project. Constructed, and programmed ROS packages for tracking objects with the OpenCV library from a video or a USB camera stream in the ROS ecosystem.
